title: Data Governance Specialist
description:
Join our team
The TELUS Data & Trust Office provides world-class, innovative privacy solutions to TELUS. We partner with teams across the organization to advance our corporate priorities, support innovation and ultimately deliver on our promise to safeguard our customer’s privacy and to earn and maintain their trust. We see compliance with the law as our starting point and we passionately pursue opportunities to demonstrate respect for our customers and their data through transparent, robust, and ethical data practices.
Our team takes pride in earning a reputation for being innovative thought-leaders, strategic business partners and subject-matter experts in privacy and data governance.
TELUS recognizes the great potential of data to meet business needs in our world today, consistent with our position on social capitalism. Data governance supports TELUS’ commitment to respectfully treat data in a manner that fosters innovation and at the same time mitigates the array of privacy, security and ethical risks. We earn our stakeholders trust- across the business and with our customers- using the data governance principles of accountability, ethical use and transparency to deliver value from data, in accordance with the TELUS Trust model.
Here’s the impact you’ll make and what we’ll accomplish together
As the Data Governance Specialist, reporting to the Director of Data Ethics & Governance, you will significantly influence the ongoing development and roll-out of TELUS’ data governance program. You will work with a cross-functional group focused on enabling the growth of the business through responsible use of data. At the same time, you will be an integral member of the Data Ethics & Governance team. This team is tasked with solving some of our organization's most complex challenges while building a thriving community of practice around data ethics and data governance.
Your technical background in data engineering, data analysis and/or data science will support the team in implementing the data governance strategy with new processes and technology that will accelerate and scale the digital transformation and data driven opportunities.
You will be a champion for data governance across the organization and you will advocate for TELUS’ Trust Model as the fundamental driver for all of our decisions around data, recognizing how critical customer and team member trust is to TELUS’ mission. Your contributions to the data governance program will be an integral part of our commitment to leverage data in a respectful manner and our thought-leadership on anticipating challenges at the intersection of privacy, ethics, technology and data.
Here’s how

  • Support the design and implementation of a data governance program that helps TELUS organize and understand data to exceed stakeholder expectations while simultaneously ensuring TELUS’ ability to respectfully leverage data assets to deliver value
  • Contribute to the strategic direction for the evolution of data governance at TELUS, designing and operating policies and processes for data enablement by the business using an agile development methodology
  • Enhance data literacy across TELUS, providing education and support to the data user community and network of Data Stewards on data governance and responsible innovation topics to provide strategies for establishing reliable and accurate data outcomes

  • Contribute to industry working groups and provide thought leadership on standards for data governance and responsible innovation
  • Learn continuously, innovate every day and seek opportunities to develop and demonstrate thought-leadership

You’re the missing piece of the puzzle

  • Experienced in implementing data governance practices and best-in-class principles for data management
  • Valued for your knowledge and expertise in data governance technology, business process modeling, metadata, data lineage, data quality and enterprise implementation of data governance tools and solutions (Collibra and/or One Trust preferred)

  • Recognized for your leadership capabilities to collaborate and accomplish goals with others including experience partnering with multiple stakeholders across an organization, including lines of business, information technology, architecture and operations
  • Able to identify and proactively consider opportunities outside of conventional thinking to resolve problems and address gaps
  • Demonstrated track record of defining and delivering measurable outcomes for customers and the business in a highly complex stakeholder environment
  • Effective in written communication and verbally communicating progress on initiatives in leadership forums
  • Trusted as a collaborative partner who will act with integrity to fulfill TELUS’ commitments to its customers
  • Recognized for your excellent interpersonal skills to build and foster relationships across all levels of the organization
  • Known for your ability to influence and negotiate effectively, to be a persuasive advocate
  • Sought after for your excellent and problem solving skills and your ability to distill complex and/or ambiguous problems into clear, actionable requirements
  • Highly adaptable, and comfortable working in a demanding and fast-paced environment

title: Project Manager
description:
PROJECT MANAGER

As part of Industry Innovation’s team, the Project Manager will act as an interface between external industry sponsors and internal Vector research activities. They will ensure the coordination and delivery of Vector industry initiatives to meet the direct needs of Vector’s industry sponsors ranging from large enterprises to small startups.

The Project Manager will work to take the cutting-edge research in AI by Vector’s world-class researchers and integrate it into programming that the industry can absorb. This integration will be achieved through projects, roundtables, courses, workshops, talks, academic papers, blogs, and events.

  • Capture success stories that can be used for public relations;

  • Prepare reporting as required for industry sponsors, Vector’s senior staff & its Board of Directors;

  • Provide support and insight on industry sponsors to the Industry Innovation team; and,

  • Other related duties as assigned.

  • Vector achieves its goals for its industry sponsor relationships.

  • Industry sponsor feedback via informal and formal feedback mechanisms validates that Vector is providing appropriate services and support through effective working relationships.

  • 3+ years of experience leading medium - large sized projects with startup, consulting, or corporate background experience preferred

  • Brings a combination of domain expertise in data science and/or machine learning, along with practical industry experience. Experience designing, planning, and delivering professional development programs is preferred.

title: Manager, Data, Analytics and Automation-Snowflake

What you will do

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. Notre mission est d’utiliser les données et l’analytique pour offrir de la valeur à nos clients. What will your typical day look like?

Our mission is to use data and analytics to deliver value for our clients. Our team understands exactly how data underpins a business and how improving the management, use and insight from this data improves performance and reduces risk. We also help clients manage the new risks and safely leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

For this role, we are seeking Senior Consultants who will help deliver on our ambitious plans to grow our practice. As a Senior Consultant, you will be working collaboratively across the data and analytics domains, helping some of the largest, most interesting organizations in the world imagine, deliver and run the future - transforming complex business problems and requirements into practical, implementable solutions.

Work with Risk and Regulatory data and technology leaders globally to combine innovative thinking with program and technological execution. Work for a world-class organization that provides an exceptional career experience with an inclusive and collaborative team.

Working in our Data and Analytics team offers a dynamic, fast-paced environment, which presents you with the opportunity to continually grow and learn from people with different backgrounds and working styles.

We combine our people's skills and experience, with Deloitte tools and solutions, across four focus capability areas across the end-to-end Risk Spectrum.

  • Risk Data Strategy & Architecture
  • Risk Data Modelling & Engineering
  • Risk Data Analytics, Reporting & Insights
  • Risk Data Governance & Management

The successful candidate will have responsibility to:

  • Support our clients to grow responsibly through the use of applied data and analytics.

  • Support the establishment of a repeatable analytical models and approaches for clients.
  • Work with other Deloitte functions to further the use of data & analytics in go to market activities.
  • Enhance the value of our deliverables and the insights provided by our work.
  • Support in reviews of data and data use for regulatory compliance and process and control effectiveness.
  • Work with existing clients to design and develop programs for data and analytics.

Furthermore, Data and Analytics team is an integral part of Deloitte's risk capabilities, and our OneDeloitte' strategy enables individuals to work with our risk domain specialists in different areas across our core Risk and Regulatory domains.

Our advisory domains include, but are not limited to, Financial Risk (Credit, Market, Liquidity) Management, Non-Financial Risk (Operation, Reputation, Strategic Risk) Management, Regulatory Compliance, Financial Crime (Fraud, AML, Insider) Management, Treasury and Capital Management, IT Risk Control, Internal Audit, Organizational Crisis and Resilience Management, Extended Enterprise Risk Management, Sustainability and ESG, as well as Cyber Risk.

About the team

We are the one of the largest Risk and Regulatory practices in Canada. Our Data and Analytics team is a key capability within Risk and Regulatory. We are a growing team with initiatives across multiple industries and use cases. We support organizations with all aspects of data and analytics related to risk management. We aim to bring recognized value to each engagement; be it setting up a program to deliver on long term strategic objectives or solutioning for tactical needs under demanding timelines. We have extensive experience that we draw upon daily and are always looking to the future and innovative solutions and opportunities.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

In this role, the expected qualifications are:

  • Exceptional planning, organization, project and people management skills
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, business writing and professional skills, including being able to liaise with both technical and business contacts at our clients
  • 4+ years of experience in Financial Services Industry in a consulting or industry capacity
  • 4+ years of experience in Risk and Regulatory Compliance areas in a consulting or industry capacity
  • 4+ years of experience in delivering a broad range of data analytics engagements in areas such as, Data Strategy, Data Architecture, Data Migration, Data Analytics, Data Governance and Data Quality
  • 4+ years of experience in applying Data Analytics, ML/AI and/or other insights approaches to deliver business value
  • 4+ years of experience in working with analytical, visualization and data engineering capabilities
  • 4+ years of experience in working with cloud capabilities is an asset
  • Ability to synthesize large amounts of information to produce clear, concise, and logical presentations and reports
  • Ability to work in a fast paced and demanding environment, both independently and in a team setting
  • Ability to establish priorities and meet challenging deadlines
  • Curiosity and comfortability with ambiguity
  • Undergraduate or Graduate Degree in relevant field; relevant professional qualification is an asset
  • Willingness/flexibility of traveling to client locations, as required

  • 10+ years of experience in Data Science; at least 5 years of experience in independently leading projects/modeling; at least 2 years leading a major functional area

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

title: Senior Manager - Data Architect - Toronto
description:
Senior Manager - Data Architect - Toronto

Location: Toronto
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Date: Apr 27, 2023
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Data Architect that can translate business strategies and requirements into world-class technical solutions, applications, and process designs. The role assumes the responsibility for all technical aspects of solution delivery, from inception through design to implementation. They will conduct regular detailed solution analysis and provide expert judgment pertaining to highly complex technical issues including all aspects related to development, infrastructure, data, and configuration management perspectives. This role requires a rare blend of skills normally found in the specialized roles of Cloud Architect, Data Analyst, Data Engineer and Reporting Specialist. The Data Architect will also assist in the establishment and enforcement of architectural standards and best practices to ensure consistency in data solutions delivery across development teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and provide oversight into the design of end-to-end data solutions including data architecture, data integration, data modelling, security, privacy, regulatory, performance, data governance, business intelligence, etc. and to ensure alignment to the overall business needs
  • Provide technical oversight and recommendations on data infrastructure (on-prem and Cloud)
  • Lead discovery sessions with primary business stakeholders to obtain knowledge of business objectives, challenges, and requirements
  • Present and socialize proposed solutions to technical boards during review sessions as well as articulate and communicate designs to stakeholder groups
  • Support solution delivery by providing insights to the application development teams and project managers that plan and execute delivery activities
  • Support implementation processes in association with internal and external development teams. Participate in project-related activities.
  • Assume responsibility for the quality of the implemented solution and its adherence to technology strategies, standards, and best practices
  • Create solution architecture documents that describe and explain solution attributes and associated benefits
  • Stay current on emergent technologies relevant to supporting the data solutions delivered for customers
  • Support the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of solution management methodologies, including obtaining feedback after the solution has been implemented
  • Assist in the identification and recommendation of appropriate solutions, upgrades, replacements, or decommissioning options incorporating business and technology productivity, usability, and total cost of ownership


To qualify for the role you must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Related professional certifications and/or training is considered an asset.
  • 10+ years demonstrated experience in the design and implementation of modern data architectures to support large scale data solutions
  • Expert knowledge of data patterns to support architectures and data management concepts/processes including ETL/ELT, Data Mesh, date lake, data lakehouse, data warehouse, data streaming, data virtualization, etc.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling (dimensional, data vault, etc.) principles and techniques based on established methodologies (e.g., Kimball).
  • Strong knowledge of ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, etc. as well as standards and best practices for ETL development
  • Strong knowledge of data governance framework principles and vendor platforms (e.g., Collibra, Informatica EDC/Axon)
  • Experience with data manipulation and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, etc.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and demonstrated ability to apply SQL to a wide variety of business requirements.
  • Strong Knowledge of ETL frameworks using Azure Data Factory and Databricks Notebooks.
  • Strong knowledge in data warehousing concepts and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks)
  • Strong knowledge of Azure-based architecture and services such as RBAC, AAD, VM, ADLS, Azure DevOps, and Events hub.
  • Proficient in building secure architecture using: Encryption, Azure key vault, Access control, Network security, and Advanced data security.
  • Knowledge of MDM concepts and solutions
  • Demonstrated experience deploying data solutions in Big Data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary, distributed, and collaborative environments.


What we look for

We’re interested in passionate leaders with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the IT Advisory space. If you have a strong passion for helping businesses achieve their IT strategy, this role is for you.

What we offer

At EY, our Total Rewards package supports our commitment to creating a leading people culture - built on high-performance teaming - where everyone can achieve their potential and contribute to building a better working world for our people, our clients and our communities. It's one of the many reasons we repeatedly win awards for being a great place to work.


We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

  • Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
  • Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Diversity and Inclusion at EY

Diversity and inclusiveness are at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. From our actions to combat systemic racism and our advocacy for the LGBT+ community to our innovative Neurodiversity Centre of Excellence and Accessibility initiatives, we welcome and embrace the diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds and perspectives that make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Purpose of Job:

As Manager, IFRS 9 Modelling & Analytics, Enterprise Stress Testing, you will contribute to the overall success of IFRS 9 credit risk modelling, analytics, and reporting for retail and small business portfolios. You will ensure specific individual goals, plans, and initiatives are executed / delivered in support of the team’s business strategies and objectives. title: Data Engineer Lead, Digital Pathology
description:
The Position

The Digital Pathology (DP) Data Services Team within Roche provides data management, generation, and validation services to support DP science, discovery & commercial product teams in their algorithm research and development. We are an incredibly motivated, smart and diverse group of unique individuals united in our mission to improve the lives of every patient afflicted with cancer.


We are seeking an excellent, experienced and highly skilled Data Engineer lead for DP Data Management with a strong technical background rooted in fundamental computer science and database management.


Given the collaborative nature of our team we are looking for someone with a flexible and learning mindset, the ability to work in a fluid and dynamic environment, and a strong desire to pursue creative solutions to challenging problems following the highest standards in the industry.


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion, design, build and support of a data management system or database, cloud and/or open source, to process and manage histopathological meta data to support product development, exploratory research, or on-market applications.
  • Building highly scalable data management systems and associative architecture to support millions of highly heterogeneous histopathology data sets
  • Being able to work across multiple, multi-disciplinary teams internal/external to gather requirements and ensure project development is aligned to those requirements.
  • Being able to work with parsing, managing, analyzing and making available large sets of (histopathological) data to turn information into insights using multiple platforms.
  • Working at all stages of the software life cycle: Proof of Concept, MVP, Production, and Deprecation
  • Build peer relationships with Roche IT and build a in-depth knowledge of Roche data systems and information strategies to inform DP Data Services Strategies
  • Lead internal projects for new or upgraded systems, applications, data manipulation or reporting solutions and acting as the connection between the DP Data Services team and other Roche groups (e.g. Roche IT, Pharma, etc.)
  • Proactively identify automation opportunities where the use of systems or the collation of data or information for reporting are highly manual or fragmented
  • Develop and maintain tools for monitoring and/or improving compliance and ensuring data integrity


Qualifications

  • A BS in a computer science/computational science discipline with 12 years of work experience or a Masters with 7 years of experience (preferred)
  • 5+ years experience architecting and developing scalable data pipelines, frameworks and platforms to power data science efforts in distributed cloud environments; solid knowledge of HPC and AWS based data engineering and analytics solutions
  • Significant experience with storage technologies and their advantages and disadvantages (e.g. Relational Database, No-SQL Database, Object Storage); experience with one specific NoSQL solution, like DynamoDB, MongoDB, or Cassandra and understanding the different use cases for a NoSQL solution vs a SQL solution.
  • Extensive experience in designing, developing and maintaining databases. Proficiency in data processing and management including the ability to query large data sets, including image sets.
  • Experience with various data integration/ETL tools, application integration, business process and data science tools (e.g. Talend, Kubeflow, Spark, Tableau, Flume, Kafka or Databricks)
  • Fluency in programming languages (Python, Go, Java) for data analysis
  • Professional experience in software engineering with Python including: Very good understanding of the Python Ecosystem (e.g. NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn), Coding best practices (e.g. TDD, ATDD), Application Architecture and Design Patterns, Testing strategies, Versioning
  • Experience with Structured Query Language SQL and different database engines (Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and others)
  • Experience with SQL database optimization, can distinguish between optimization for reading heavy DBs, or writing heavy DBs, and understanding about sharding and stored procedures, table-valued functions, scalar-valued functions, triggers, and more.
  • A strong willingness to learn, comfortness with ambiguity and being able to work without lots of supervision
  • Stays up-to-date with technology trends and understands its impact on the current technology portfolio
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills and able to multitask
  • Demonstrated communication skills

Preferred Skills (but not required):

  • Knowledge on image processing and computer vision
  • Strong background in statistics and hands-on experience with deep learning
  • Prior experience in digital pathology, medical imaging
  • Experience with terraform; understand how to deploy databases to the cloud in an automated way


Note: Travel to US required.

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

The Instructor and TAs will interact directly with participants on the content itself. Vector staff will grant extensions and notices of completion, and all other issues considered "customer service".

The instructor, in communication with Vector Professional Development staff, will develop and deliver content in line with the following:

Introduction

The rapid evolution of AI has significantly transformed business operations for companies. SMEs leveraging machine learning algorithms gain a competitive edge in their respective markets, can make better business decisions, and work more efficiently. Many SMEs may not have the expertise or resources to integrate machine learning into their business practices. To address these challenges, the Vector Institute has developed a new training program designed to equip SMEs with the essential skills and knowledge necessary to accelerate the implementation of machine learning for a pre-defined use case within their organizations.

Program sessions will be delivered in an interactive lecture/discussion format, with practical examples and case studies used to spark reflection and discussion. Sessions are designed to leverage learners’ prior experience, stimulate conversation, and move each company towards a Proof of Concept (PoC) by the end of the program.

Program Overview

The program is designed to cover the entire lifecycle of a machine learning project. Each module will be conducted over a period of three weeks and SMEs will be assigned a Technical Advisor (TA) to provide guidance and support throughout the program. TAs are experienced machine learning practitioners who will provide feedback on the SMEs’ work and help address any roadblocks that may arise during the program.

1. Data Readiness

Many companies face the challenge of having sparse or low-quality data or may inadvertently work with incorrect data transformations, which can all affect the accuracy of machine learning models. By the end of the module, learners will be able to:

  • Identify relevant data sources to successfully train their machine learning models
  • Apply data cleaning and preprocessing techniques for their specific data types
  • Create data visualizations to identify relevant patterns and relationships in their data
  • Identify strategies to mitigate bias and implement data governance practices within their organizations


2. Model Development

By the end of this module, learners will be able to:

  • Demonstrate the ability to select appropriate machine learning algorithm(s) for their use cases
  • Evaluate and optimize model performance
  • Develop a self-guided approach to model development that best aligns with their projects by referencing examples implemented by Vector Institute
  • Understand effective principles and practices for building trustworthy AI systems

3. Model Deployment

By the end of this module, learners will be able to:

  • Develop a strategy for deploying and integrating their machine learning models into their business practices
  • Apply effective monitoring and maintenance techniques so their deployed models will maintain a high-performance level

4. Capstone

At the end of the program, SMEs will have four weeks of dedicated time to focus on their use case, in consultation with their TA. The program culminates in a 10-minute capstone presentation where companies will have an opportunity to showcase their work and receive feedback from their peers and members of the Vector community.

Pedagogical Approach

Program sessions will be delivered in an interactive lecture/discussion format, with practical examples and case studies used to spark reflection and discussion. Sessions are designed to leverage learners’ prior experience, stimulate conversation, and move each company towards a viable Proof of Concept (PoC) by the end of the program. All sessions will be delivered online.

Level of Training and Learner Prerequisites

Hands-on examples will involve Python and will be provided in the form of Jupyter notebooks. (.ipynb files). Notebooks can be executed within a web browser using Google Colab or locally on a learner’s personal computer. Learners should be familiar with navigating the notebook environment, writing and executing Python code, and styling text using Markdown. Some external resources on these topics will also be provided prior to the start of the training program.

The program will expose learners to several open-source Python packages. Coding concepts will be delivered at an intermediate level and each company should have at least one technical participant who is familiar with the following packages:

  • numpy and pandas for manipulating arrays and dataframes
  • matplotlib or similar visualization or exploratory data analysis packages
  • scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch: popular machine learning frameworks


Compensation

Module 1 - $3,000

Module 2 - $2,000

Module 3 - $3,000

Application

To apply, please submit your CV and cover letter to learn@vectorinstitute.ai. In your application, please indicate which module(s) you are applying for.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until filled.

title: Engineering Internships, Fall 2024
description:

Our Engineering Internships are open to current university students, recent grads, self-taught learners, and career changers.

We’re looking for Software Developers with a passion for solving tough problems with performant code.   • Interns will work primarily from Shopify's Toronto office located at 620 King Street West, while still having the opportunity to work remotely on certain days.   • You love challenging yourself with projects or hacking just for fun

The successful candidate will evaluate, prototype, and implement cutting-edge statistical methods (and pipelines) to analyze large-scale genetic, genomic, and proteomic datasets. The candidate will also work with a team of scientific software engineers who will support the development of these methods into production-scale pipelines. Areas of focus will include GWAS analysis methods (fine-mapping, eQTL/pQTL co-localization, local ancestry based mapping); analysis of functional genomic data (epigenetic data and genome-wide CRISPR screen analysis) and integration with GWAS summary statistics; and analysis of gene-networks and pathways.

  • PhD in Human Statistical Genetics (or related field). MSc and significant experience also accepted. Postdoctoral experience preferred.
  • Ability to produce high-quality work with minimal supervision; this includes meeting reasonable deadlines and making sensible independent decisions.
  • Unix/Linux proficiency.
  • Fluent in R, Python, and shell scripting.
  • Familiarity with current Human Genetics methods and literature.
  • The ability to read and interpret Human Genetics publications to understand the latest tools.
  • Excellent communication, advanced English reading, writing, and speaking skills.
  • Desire to learn more about Human Genetics, Bioinformatics, and Biology

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Familiarity with C++.
  • Experience with Bioconductor libraries.
  • History of scientific authorship. (First, middle, and senior author articles all beneficial.)
  • Experience with version control (git).
  • Experience with High Performance Computing (eg. Slurm).
  • In your cover letter, please highlight publications/experience with GWAS, functional genomics analysis, and gene networks + pathways.

List of Duties

  • Evaluate alternative analytical methods relevant to the needs of Genentech Human Genetics scientists.
  • Implement working analysis pipelines that run existing/published tools.
  • Develop new tools in R or python under the guidance of Genentech Human Genetics scientists
  • Use git to track code, document the code along with examples of running the code, and provide demos to the analysts in HG group who will be using the pipelines

Vector has launched a Professional Development program called the AI Certificate Program for Industry, which is exclusive to industry sponsors. title: Automated Train Operation System Design Expert
description:
At CN, we work together to move our company—and North America—forward. Be part of our Information & Technology (I&T) team, a critical piece of the engine that keeps us in motion. From enterprise architecture to operational technology, our teams use the agile methodology to automate and digitize our railroad ensuring our operations run optimally and safely and our employees can focus on value-added tasks. You will be able to develop your skills and career in our close-knit, safety-focused culture working together as ONE TEAM. The careers we offer are meaningful because the work we do matters. Join us!

JOB SUMMARY

The role of Expert Automated Train Operation System Design is to ensure production of detailed functional design for solution subsystem components, whether based on a packaged solution or on custom development. This involves working with Product Management, Architecture and end users to understand the End-to-End Architecture and requirements and flesh out a detailed system design for the specific component or area of expertise. This includes defining subsystem architecture and detailed functional level design and development plan as well being the overall owner of the conceptual subsystem solution during the development, testing, and integration stage. Another key responsibility is to work in close partnership with the Technical Delivery lead to provide clear and exact impact assessments in the initial phase of the development process. Additional responsibilities include supporting designers, developers and integrators during the full design and test cycle.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

System Design

  • Analyze overall system issues and/or business requirements to design effective, high-availability, business-critical solutions

  • Understand high-level proposed architecture and transpose it into subsystem designs that will meet all functional and non-functional requirements. The developed designs will then be elaborated by the design and development resources.

  • Create standards and best practices that ensure the systems design is maintainable, sustainable and properly documented with all the associated IP constructs

  • Create standards and best practices that ensure reliability, safety and cybersecurity standards are imbedded in the design of the sub systems

  • Work with Manager to define domain best practices and standards for the System Designers

  • Understand Rail subsystems Architecture in order to develop Specifications on technical Design aspects (Hardware & Software integration)

  • Design and propose enhancements and modifications to the subsystem architecture

  • When called upon, will be required to work with FRA and CN personnel in the various regulatory inspections to ensure all requirements are properly designed

  • Be a champion to the systems designers on adoption of proper detailed development and designs

  • Work with Manager to drive best practices and a practice based approach towards system design

Delivery & Quality

  • Conduct impact assessments for proposed architecture to help with delivery strategy

  • Provide, or verify, work estimates. Evaluate/assess upgrades, priorities and criticality.

  • Define deployment plan and support Q&A and Integration Engineers from a technical subsystem product owner perspective

  • Ensure compliance with and oversee development, and execution of testing strategies, test plans, and test procedures to validate that the system correctly implements the specifications

  • Work with Manager and technical leads to help plan the release

  • Work with Quality leads, Management, and QA to constantly monitor quality KPI’s and implement design improvements

  • Be the technical lead and technical authority throughout the delivery and lifecycle of the solution

REQUIREMENTS

Experience

  • Proven track record of success in complex system engineering environments

  • Minimum 10-15 years overall work experience (including in system integration of a complex train control system and in software engineering and design)

  • Minimum 5 years demonstrating technical leadership qualities and/or overseeing deliverables (including in a leadership role of leading developers or integrators)

Education/Certification/Designation

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related field

Skills/Knowledge

  • Excellent oral, written and presentation skills

  • Strong ability to analyze, design & document detailed designs

  • Knowledge of automated train operation (ATO) environment, automated control systems, grades of automation and supervisory systems

  • Knowledge of automated train operation (ATO) situational awareness and hazard detection systems

  • Excellent knowledge of system engineering & design processes (ISO/IEC 15288 & 12207 or equivalent)

  • Knowledge of system engineering modelling and requirements management tools

  • Knowledge of railway safety engineering practices (IEC 61508, EN 50126/IEC 62278, EN 50128/IEC 62279 and EN 50129/IEC 62425) or equivalent from other industries

  • Strong ability to analyze, design & document detailed designs

  • Ability to provide, verify and validate work estimates

  • Proficient in documentation of complex concepts such as impact analysis, security models, performance and capacity planning, and strategic technical decision

Assets

  • Knowledge of railway freight environments in North America

  • Knowledge of train control (ATC) & protection (ATP) systems (railway signaling, interlocking, European Train Control System, Positive Train Control, Communication-Based Train Control, etc.)

  • Knowledge of train supervision (ATS) systems (dispatching, movement planning, conflict detection, decision support system, etc.)

  • Experience in working with Agile and Dev(Sec)Ops development organizations

  • Managing Life cycle of delivery of complex system

  • Experience with executive presentations

About CN

CN is a world-class transportation leader and trade-enabler. Essential to the economy, to the customers, and to the communities it serves, CN safely transports more than 300 million tons of natural resources, manufactured products, and finished goods throughout North America every year. As the only railroad connecting Canada’s Eastern and Western coasts with the Southern tip of the U.S. through a 19,500 mile rail network, CN and its affiliates have been contributing to community prosperity and sustainable trade since 1919. CN is committed to programs supporting social responsibility and environmental stewardship. At CN, we work as ONE TEAM, focused on safety, sustainability and our customers, providing operational and supply chain excellence to deliver results.

Business data engineers play an indispensable role in assembling the necessary data products that fuel myriad of analytical models used by our various business units across Canada.

Reporting to the Director of Business Data Engineering, the Business Data Engineer will be a key member of Canadian Analytics CoE responsible for building enriched data products that provide deep insights about our Client, Advisor, Product, Transactions along with their intricate relationships. The Business Data Engineer will work with data analysts and data scientists to help answer complex business enquires such as identifying new business opportunities, understanding our client behaviour and optimizing areas of our sales cycles.

  • Work with our Data Science teams to implement Machine Learning pipelines

Education and Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent
  • Graduate degree in business or quantitative science strongly preferred
  • 3-5 years hands-on experience working on Cloud Platforms (on AWS, Azure, etc.) with data processing and analytical tools such as Hive SQL, Apache Spark, AWS Glue, etc.
  • 5 years hands-on experience with relational database systems, data warehouses, dimensional models etc.

  • Experience working in a large financial services organization

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer
description:
Make a difference in brain research and innovation in Ontario   

The Ontario Brain Institute (OBI) is a provincially‐funded, not‐for‐profit initiative seeking to maximize the impact of neuroscience and establish Ontario as a world leader in brain discovery, commercialization and care. Convergent partnerships are created between researchers, clinicians, industry, patients, and their advocates to foster discovery and deliver innovative products and services that improve the lives of those living with brain disorders.   

The OBI is passionate about the outcomes of its work, the people and organizations it partners with, and the opportunity to play a role in shaping the future. Its members are united in the common goal to improve brain health. The culture is fast-paced, challenging and rewarding.   

If you are interested in joining the OBI team, please check out the employment opportunities at: http://www.braininstitute.ca/opportunities 

Cloud Systems Engineer - 1 Position

OBI is looking for an experienced Cloud Systems Engineer to join its neuroinformatics team. This role will play a key part in supporting OBI related research projects that produce, share, and analyze high quality neuroscience data to advance neuroscience and brain discoveries via Brain-CODE. Brain-CODE is OBI’s large scale neuroinformatics platform for the collection, curation, sharing, and analysis of neuroscience data.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for advancing neuroscience informatics (neuroinformatics) via the adoption and scaling of advanced and secure cloud architectures, data systems, computing systems, and network systems. Candidates should have significant experience implementing and managing cloud systems architectures, infrastructure, cloud frameworks, deployment and support, preferably with experience in the health research ecosystem or similar.

This position will be a great opportunity for the successful candidate to develop their cloud operations, security and management of cloud IaaS and PaaS services. This opportunity will also be a chance to collaborate with national and international partners, and significantly participate in supporting the advancement of brain discovery and innovation for health impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead technical cloud infrastructure and platform layers for health research data storage, sharing, and analysis on Microsoft Azure cloud and connected computing environments.
  • Implement best-in-class cloud networking, firewalls, VPNs to enforce robust cybersecurity measures and ongoing systems logging and monitoring.
  • Implement and support cloud storage and backup and recovery infrastructure via object stores, databases, and file systems in accordance with OBI cloud informatics guidelines.
  • Manage and support cloud resources, storage, and computing instances, analytics instances, in accordance with robust policies and standard operating procedures (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, etc.).
  • Implement and support scalable private cloud and public cloud infrastructure and platforms.
  • Manage and support cloud IAM infrastructure, cloud administrative accounts, and integration services.
  • Support security assessments, change management and implement contingency plans for system upgrades and providing impact analysis and recommendation for system updates.
  • Support the updating and development of OBI cloud security guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as required.
  • Operate cloud resource budgets with due diligence and planning.
  • Collaborate with third-party DevOps and Security providers, Microsoft Azure partners, and other third-party partners to advance neuroinformatics objectives.
  • Collaborate and support OBI service providers with systems access and services deployments.
  • Work closely with the OBI neuroinformatics team and service providers with agility and adapt to ongoing requirements changes.
  • Keep abreast of and communicate cloud platforms and infrastructure technology and security standards, cloud trends and innovation opportunities.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5 to 7+ years' experience with preference given to candidates with health research cloud systems experience. Relevant MSc or PhD, an asset.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with Azure Cloud computing systems management, deployment, monitoring, migration, and support – certifications in Azure Solutions Architecture, Administrator, and Security Engineer or similar cloud systems and security certification(s) are major assets.
  • Proven ability to adopt agile methodology and proficiency in cloud system optimization and tuning (Virtual Machines, load balancing, Kubernetes, Azure App Services, Azure Storage, etc).
  • Demonstrated experience working with sensitive data and implementing robust security postures, policies, and procedures including systems monitoring, backups, intrusion detection, intrusion response, and disaster recovery.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience working with authentication protocols, ACL rules, and Identity Management mechanisms including federated identity applications and management (e.g., Azure AD, SAMBA, OAuth, etc.).
  • Experience with CLI based cloud management and orchestrating infrastructure as code (az-cli, bicep, terraform, etc.).
  • Strong knowledge of network principles and protocols, network security, and application and user access patterns, such as IP subnetting, routing, firewall rules, VPNs, Virtual Private Cloud, load balancers, cloud DNS, cloud CDN, etc.
  • Robust understanding of cloud data and application layers for staging databases, applications, containers, and data storage services on Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience operating with cloud resource budgets, quotas, and support.
  • Ability to derive cloud applications and data management insights and innovation without compromising robustness, usability, and efficiency.
  • Possesses excellent analytical and problem resolution skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and English proficiency with a willingness to teach and share lessons learned with the neuroinformatics team.
  • Excellent autonomy along with great collaboration skills.
  • A strong desire to make an impact in brain discovery and patient health.

The Cloud Systems Engineer will work alongside the Cloud Application Engineer, the Data Quality Analysts, the informatics service providers to OBI, and the broader neuroinformatics team.

We are a diverse, highly energized, passionate, professional and committed team. We offer an exciting workplace with many opportunities for learning. Qualified candidates are invited to submit a cover letter and resume, by September 10, 2023.

title: Machine Learning Scientist
description:
About ChainML

ChainML is a startup founded by a team of experienced tech executives and machine learning experts, including 3 Vector Institute alumni. We’re building Council - an open-source Agent-based framework that simplifies the integration and amplifies the utility of state-of-the-art generative AI models like GPT-4 and Llama-2 into business applications.

About the Role

At ChainML, Machine Learning Scientists are responsible for developing and integrating state-of-the-art techniques for leveraging large language models (LLMs) and other foundation models in Council. We are particularly interested in advanced control flow mechanisms as well as techniques for planning, evaluation and measurably improving response quality, safety, and fairness in deployments. ML Scientists also prepare high-quality demos, reference solutions, documentation, tutorials, technical papers, research articles, and other supporting materials for Council.

As a Research Team member, you will collaborate closely with our Engineering team. You will make regular contributions to our open-source repositories. You will also occasionally collaborate and participate in calls with our customer-facing teams (Product, Education & Services) to help deliver required functionality for customer-specific deployments, but customer solutioning is not the focus of this role.

ML Scientist Profile

While the following is what we imagine to be an ideal candidate profile, we welcome applications from any qualified candidate. We value adjacent experience and transferable skills.

Technical

  • You have formal, graduate level training in computer science, mathematics, software engineering or a related discipline.
  • You have expert-level Python skills.
  • You have professional software development experience related to AI, ML, or data science with strong knowledge of related frameworks (e.g. transformers, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • You are highly literate in the AI research space. You regularly read research papers and other technical publications as part of your work.
  • You are excited about building frameworks and applications on top of foundation models including proprietary models like GPT-4 and more open models like Llama 2.
  • You are passionate about the measurable impact of your work, and you are equally excited about publishing code and supporting material.
  • You have recent experience developing, training, and fine-tuning deep learning models.
  • You have experience with reinforcement learning and/or complex search techniques.
  • You have research interest and expertise in AI safety and fairness.

Other

  • You have excellent communication skills including professional level English language skills.
  • You are excited to meaningfully engage with user communities via diverse platforms.
  • You are comfortable working in a startup environment where shifting focus is necessary from time to time.
  • You are comfortable and productive in a primarily work-from-home environment.
  • You reach out to peers and managers proactively when you need assistance or to share ideas.
  • You are confidently creative and excited to share your ideas.

Core Responsibilities

  • Research and adopt state-of-the-art techniques for improving the utility of LLMs in practice, including via the coordination of LLM-based agents.
  • Develop demos, prototypes, reference solutions, and supporting material that highlight Council’s core capabilities.
  • Research, design, adopt, and implement techniques for improving LLM output quality, debiasing, reliability, and safety (including techniques for scalable oversight).
  • Research, design, adopt, and implement techniques for improved control flow, planning, decision making, chaining, and delegation.
  • Review, distill, and present emerging concepts in the generative AI literature.
  • Suggest framework improvements and new features based on emerging techniques, user requests, and your own experience building with Council.
  • Design and implement solutions for ML or data science user or customer use cases as needed (e.g. implementing predictive modeling skills for Council agents).
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of robust evaluation and quality assurance mechanisms.
  • Contribute to technical and non-technical writing about responsible AI deployment for business use cases
  • Collaborate with customer-facing teams as-needed to develop new capabilities or advanced technical solutions
  • Collaborate with Engineering to make production-quality code contributions to the open source Council framework
  • Prepare and deliver talks, technical workshops, and tutorials at community events
  • Develop and deliver other supporting content, like demo videos, code-along sessions, and live virtual events.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to influence an early stage startup in the Generative AI space
  • Great career development opportunities at a fast growing company
  • Competitive compensation including share of equity
  • Extended health plan including vision, dental, prescriptions, and paramedicals
  • Time off for employees based in Ontario

    • 3 weeks vacation (15 days)
    • 3 floating holidays (3 days)
    • Annual company holiday between Christmas and New Year’s Day (incl. Christmas Day, Boxing Day, and New Year’s Day)

STATEMENT OF WORK: Fairness in Language Models (LMs) - Instructor

The instructor will be contracted to deliver a lecture on October 25, 2023, 9:30 am – 12:30 pm ET. This is day 1 of a three-day initiative in a lab format, which is scheduled for October 25-27, 2023. The laboratory project format is a short engagement aimed for exploration and experimentation.

Over three days the lab will focus on enhancing participant understanding of fairness and bias mitigation in Language Models (LMs) using various research-based techniques. At a time where LM applications hold significant influence, auditing for fairness is of most importance. This lab incorporates lectures, demonstrations, code walkthroughs, and hands-on exploration and concludes with a showcase day.

Program Dates: October 25 - 27, 2023

Instructor Engagement: October 25, 2023, 9:30am – 12:30pm ET

Location: The lecture will be delivered online via Zoom

Instructor activities include:

  • Coordinate with Vector’s Professional Development (PD), Projects and AI Engineering teams on workshop logistics and support needs
  • Prepare lecture content (e.g. lesson objectives, slides, and discussion prompts)
  • Deliver one 3-hour lecture to a high standard of service, actively engage with participants, and respond to questions.
  • Attend touch base course meetings - planning and debriefing with Vector teams

Fees: This is a paid position. The flat fee for this workshop is $1650 (CAD) in total for development, delivery, and administration. An invoice must be submitted at the end of the workshop. All fees are payable at the end of the workshop, and upon completion of all contractual responsibilities.

Workshop Structure

Prior to the commencement of the workshop, touchpoints include:

  • Team kick-off/ curriculum development meeting
  • Team progress meeting

These meetings will accommodate schedules as much as possible.

Workshop Content

Please note: This is a projected high-level overview. The topics and content will be finalized once an instructor has been hired.

Participants will improve their comprehension of fairness and bias mitigation in Language Models. They will learn to identify and evaluate both data and model biases through techniques like sentence classification, named entity recognition, instruction fine-tuning, chain-of-thought prompting, and soft-prompt tuning. They will also acquire a deeper understanding of the development of Vector's UnBIAS library to mitigate bias in data and its practical application by actively participating in hands-on experiences.

Pedagogical Approach

Sessions will be delivered in an interactive lecture/discussion format, with practical examples and case studies used to spark reflection and discussion. All sessions will be delivered online via Zoom.

  • Experience with Python programming
  • Good understanding of ML and Natural Language Processing (NLP) concepts
  • Familiarity with libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch
  • Understanding of internal business processes
  • Experience working with Language Models and Hugging Face Transformers Library

Application

Interested parties are strongly encouraged to apply as soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until filled.

title: L4 Data Management (AI/ML Specialist / Developer) - Network Automation
description:
Our team and what we\'ll accomplish together

Join TELUS Technology\'s Network Automation and Intelligence team, where we\'re revolutionizing how Canada\'s leading telecommunications network operates. We\'re a dynamic group of software developers and network specialists who are building the intelligent, self-healing network of tomorrow. Our mission? To leverage cutting-edge AI and machine learning to predict network issues before they happen, optimize performance in real-time, and deliver exceptional experiences to millions of Canadians.

As part of our team, you\'ll be at the intersection of telecommunications and artificial intelligence, working on problems that directly impact network reliability, efficiency, and innovation. We\'re not just maintaining infrastructure—we\'re building intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and evolve. Your work will power everything from predictive maintenance algorithms that prevent outages to ML models that optimize network traffic across our national infrastructure. If you\'re passionate about applying AI to solve real-world problems at massive scale, this is where you belong.

What you\'ll do

  • Design and develop end-to-end ML/AI pipelines that process terabytes of network telemetry data to predict failures, optimize performance, and automate network operations
  • Build and optimize robust ETL/ELT workflows using GCP tools (Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Composer) to ingest, transform, and prepare network data from diverse sources for ML model training and inference
  • Implement and maintain AI integration protocols including MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to enable seamless communication between AI models and network data sources, tools, and external systems
  • Collaborate with network engineering teams, data scientists, and platform architects to identify automation opportunities and translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions
  • Create and deploy production-grade machine learning models for network anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, and intelligent routing optimization
  • Develop standardized protocols and APIs for AI model serving, ensuring efficient context sharing and tool integration across distributed network automation systems
  • Partner with DevOps and MLOps teams to implement CI/CD pipelines for model deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement in GCP environments
  • Build data quality frameworks and monitoring systems to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data flowing through our ML pipelines
  • Drive the adoption of best practices in feature engineering, model versioning, experiment tracking, and protocol-based AI integrations across the network automation domain
  • Analyze complex network datasets using advanced statistical methods and ML techniques to uncover insights that inform strategic network planning decisions
  • Support the migration and modernization of legacy data systems to cloud-native architectures, ensuring scalability and performance
  • Influence technical strategy by staying current with emerging AI/ML technologies, protocols, and recommending innovative approaches to network automation challenges

What you bring

  • Bachelor\'s or Master\'s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, or related technical field
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments
  • Deep understanding of ML/AI concepts including supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, time-series forecasting, and anomaly detection
  • Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost)
  • Proven experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale data processing
  • Solid expertise with GCP services including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Firestore, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and dimensional modeling
  • Knowledge of API design, RESTful services, and communication protocols for AI/ML systems
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code with proper testing and documentation
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business problems into technical solutions

Great-to-haves

  • Experience implementing MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or similar AI integration protocols for context management and tool orchestration
  • Familiarity with telecommunications networks, network protocols (SNMP, NetFlow, gRPC), or infrastructure monitoring systems
  • Knowledge of MLOps practices and tools (Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow) for model lifecycle management and real-time streaming data processing in network environments
